marks.gloss_en: ואי מכללא מאי? דילמא הני מילי במתניתין, אבל בברייתא לא -- perhaps the rule holds only for a mishna, not a baraita
and moreover, R' Akiva retracted in favour of R' Yehoshua
תניא כוותיה דשמואל: face, hands and feet, but not the whole body even limb by limb
the baraita: [with water heated on Shabbat eve] one washes face, hands and feet, but not his whole body even limb by limb -- and all the more so water heated on a Festival
ואי לא שמיעא ליה ודאי עביד, דאמר אביי: in all matters the Master acts as Rav except three
כחומרי דרב עביד, כקולי דרב לא עביד -- he follows Rav's stringencies, not his leniencies
Abaye: in all matters the Master acts as Rav [except these three]
מיתיבי: face, hands and feet but not the whole body -- תיובתא דרב (provisional; reversed by the answer)

אמר לך רב: 'not the whole body' -- at once, but limb by limb [it is permitted]. [Counter: והא פניו ידיו ורגליו קתני! -- answered: כעין פניו ידיו ורגליו, i.e. limb by limb like those; the counter-round cannot be encoded as an attack on this answer]
Rav: water heated on Shabbat eve -- the next day one washes his whole body with it, limb by limb
תא שמע: they permitted washing with water heated on Shabbat eve only face, hands and feet
הכא נמי כעין פניו ידיו ורגליו -- here too, [limb by limb] like face, hands and feet
the baraita: they permitted washing with water heated on Shabbat eve only the face, hands and feet
does Rabba act in accordance with Rav's ruling [bathing in pre-heated water on Shabbat]?
a bathhouse whose openings were sealed on Shabbat eve -- after Shabbat one bathes in it immediately

Rav Yehuda: in the Bnei Brak bathhouse, sealed on Festival eve, R' Elazar ben Azarya and R' Akiva entered on the Festival, sweated, and rinsed in the outer room -- but its hot water was covered with boards
bar Kappara: at first people would bathe [on Shabbat] in water heated on Shabbat eve (his answer to מאי עוברי עבירה)
Rava: one who violates [a decree of] the Rabbis may be called a transgressor
